reviews.text: I had the best ER vet experience here. Everyone was incredibly kind and took great care of my dog while she was hospitalized. I’m extremely grateful for their professionalism, compassion, and how they kept me updated every step of the way.
Everyone was very kind. Our Lila received excellent care. I would definitely refer others.
The staff were very caring and courteous.  The prices for my dogs care seemed excessive.
The staff was extremely friendly and cooperative, communitcate well with us and about our pets issue.

We had brought in our dog Ottis as a referral from our primary vet because of a mass that quickly developed under his anus. Dr.Jankovits was a complete Godsend. He performed the surgery the wound healed beautifully and you would have never known that he ever had surgery. Not only that, but Dr. Jankovits was very clear and compassionate with us. I am so grateful to God for his expertise. The clinic is also very clean and the staff is friendly and kind. I would most definitely recommend this clinic to any pet parent. Thank you so much.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!

This place is incredible!
The entire staff was kind, gentle, and very communicative throughout the entire process! Like everyone. I was a frantic fur parent who walked in needing to be seen by ER or internal medicine for blood in vomit and bloody stools. I called and to my luck one appointment cancelled and it was 12 minutes to 10 am and I was 10 min away! Made it in time! From the start, the staff was incredible in communicating the plan and getting my dogs records from my primary vet!
Keanu and I then met Dr. Erger.
Let me tell you guys, we have seen a lot of vets in our time.. She is one of the best! She listens. She asks all the right questions. She doesn’t rush you. She does not dismiss any of your concerns. She gives great feedback and teaches as she explains what’s going on so any person can understand. She’s thorough and runs the exams she thinks are necessary. Keanu Reeves (my puppy) was taken to the back where he was scanned and tests were ran. It was a few hours but I got a call from the nurse, doctor, and front desk all while waiting (again, amazing communication) and when I came back, Dr. Erger and I had a lengthy discussion of the plan moving forward. My puppy is doing much better 24 hours later and we will follow up if needed. This place is great, and for anyone needing internal medicine, Dr. Erger is fantastic!
To the staff, thank you guys greatly! 🐾

After months of back and forth with our elder cat, we needed a second opinion on next steps. The Premiere Vet team and Dr. Erger were fantastic.

Earlier in the year, our cat, Gray, had a round of testing with our primary care vet and she shared that she believed he needed to see an internal medicine vet. We booked that at Med Vet where we had a truly horrific experience. (You can read my review on Google if you’re considering them vs. Premiere.)

We went back to our primary vet after to discuss what happened, next steps, etc. after more blood work, she suggested we needed more testing. We shared we needed a different recommendation because we would never go back to Med Vet. Her recommendation to Premiere was spot on.

Everything that day not only went smoothly, but was so clear on next steps. Dr. Erger had a calm and confident demeanor, shared clearly all options and her true recommendation. She called us after the testing and was the one who met us again when we went to pick up Gray. We truly felt not only in great hands but that an expert was helping guide the treatment plan. The entire staff was kind, clear and helpful.

We would very much recommend them. We will also be telling our primary care vet so they can be her #1 internal medicine vet referral.

My experience at Premier Veterinary Group was excellent. Dr. Simpson took care of Kaleesi and explain every single detail of her test and overall health. Thank you for your support and care of those 4 legged, fury, kids including my Kaleesi!

Everyone here was very nice and welcoming, from the front desk staff to the veterinarians. They also got me a room very fast and took good care of my dog. If I ever have another emergency, I will go back here without a doubt.

Brought my senior dog in after he woke up screaming, went ridged, and his gums turned white. We were in a room within moments. A tech came about a minute later and the doc was in within minutes of him being taken to the back. He is deaf and blind, which they were very good about sharing with the rest of the team and they were very patient and gentle. The doctor took her timing explaining what was going on and walking me through the options. In the end we got a couple new meds to keep him comfortable and a plan to follow up with his primary care. I swear we were in and out in hour. The cost seemed very reasonable to me as well. We will definitely be telling other people about Premier.

This is honestly such a great ER and the Internal Medicine Department is equally great. I have a cat with complex medical needs and a habit of swallowing things and they are always so kind and great. They're quick to call you back if you have questions and really go the extra mile.

I feel so grateful to have met the internal medicine team at Premier. Dr. Simpson, Maria and Erika are second to none in Chicago.

My 11-year-old dachshund was diagnosed with an autoimmune disease and this team helped him live an extra 6.5 months, which will forever be so precious to me. Over the course of those months, I met many Premier employees, all of which treated me with empathy and showed deep care for my little one. At the end, Elizabeth (one of the nurses), took the time to connect with me on a human level to help me through the hardest choice of my life. I’ll never forget the kindness of all of the staff here (special shout out to Claudia and Maria).

Going to the emergency vet/specialist is always going to be stressful and usually expensive, but I’m glad at least in my case I felt they deeply cared about my pet and didn’t add in charges just to make an extra dollar on me. Thank you, Premier ❤️
The service was great from the front desk to the patient room. They knew exactly what the problem was. Thank you all so much for taking care of my “Puppy Kota”
I was very pleased with my visit and so was my spoiled one.
I cant express how amazing the staff is! Had a house fire brought my 2 cats who were pulled out of the fire by firemen. The staff acted fast and saved my baby's! They were so kind to me
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!

I brought my cat here recently because she was going outside her litter box. They charged me $800 only to tell me she was stressed and gave me painkillers. When I finally was able to see my regular vet it turned out she had a mass in her bladder but it was too late and now she is gone. It’s not like they were too busy to run more tests, I was the only one in there. Never taking a pet here again.

Excellent staff and veterinarians across the board. Have used this facility for my Golden Retriever and they have always provided top notch care. Dr Jankovits is an excellent surgeon and did bilateral TPLO surgeries with incredible outcomes. My dog was back to his self after the surgeries and has been thriving ever since. The ER care is also exceptional. Highly recommend!

Blonde lady comes out I'm minding my own business ask about my cat with me I informer I had her for 3 years and I rescued her from the street and she's okay I told her also I'm homeless

She then continues to pester me about the cat I had to tell her to leave me alone she then calls the police and tells the police I'm naked in my car she committed a crime by lying to the police she put the cat in danger and me in danger
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for your kind words about Premier Veterinary Group - Chicago.
Efficient, kind and timely

I took my cat, Kida, in for anorexia. Everyone was very kind and made me feel like they truly cared for her. I recieved update calls twice a day, while she was being hospitalized, and a few texts in between when there was a happy update of her eating on her own. I feel terrible I dont remember their names, but the texts at least were signed off as "Dr. B <3." They offered to set up a space so I could visit her but I live far away without a car so I really appreciated those updates. As far as price goes, I knew it would be expensive. Overnight at any hospital would be, but they let me give them a medication for her I bought previously from my primary vet so I wouldn't have to purchase more, and assured me they wouldn't do more than was absolutely necessary. That's something I really appreciate too as my emergency savings is nowhere near infinite. I wound up waiting for some time in the lobby when picking her up, but I didnt say anything as I know theyre busy caring for all the animals in need and i already had the peace of mind knowing Kida was ok. The receptionist noticed however and was so kind! She walked over herself to apologize and offered us snacks (said we could even take 2 for the wait!). Thank you to everyone at Premier that worked with my girl to get her eating again, and to those who have to face customers everyday and are still able to be kind. ♡
They did a great job with Garfunkel with his surgery.  They communicated all possible outcomes well and had a good plan in place.

My fur baby got stung by a wasp.  They were so calm and amazing.  Comforting me as well as my dog.  Very professional staff at the front desk.. I’m sorry I think her name started with an L. In and out, of which I know that is not always the case depending on the circumstances. They were wonderful.

Don’t go here unless is an absolute necessity- and even then- try not to.
225 just to see the doctor- for less than 5 minutes
100 to shave and clean a scratch wound- that they didn’t tell me was going to be added to my bill on top of that. They came in with an estimate -
That’s where I had to leave - the estimate of 600+  to wrap the ear and go home with antibiotics-I asked  what can you do that is more affordable? I asked that they wrap it by hand and use a blood stopping / clotting power they refused. Even though that’s what the vet I went to prior gave me as he sent me there because he was so booked and working alone. He didn’t have a problem with it but somehow they do because I can’t afford and 100 specialty no flap wrap that is a fraction of the price obviously online. 75% mark up on that thing.
So I paid the 325 and left with my dog bleeding,  I wrapped her up after using some blood clot powder I had for barbering nicks and will take her to my regular vet if needed. This place each time I’ve been there has a great front desk but the nurses and doctors just seem to want to rack up the bills and do a bunch of unnecessary treatment. This should have been such a simple case-

The nurse has terrible people skills and the way they have her “negotiate” the paperwork is careless and unethical. I never would have agreed to a 100 shave and “clean” they literally shaved one little spot- and extra spots that didn’t need it that I didn’t agree to. Just terrible communication- she wanted to give her a pain injection- thank god I said no- it’s literally just a tiny scratch- I was just hoping they’d clean it and tape it up- the tips of the ears bleed more because they reopen it when they shake their heads. I wish I used my credit card instead of paying cash so I could dispute the charge because the service was NOT as expected.

Great service, care, attentiveness to my cat's health, and they were successful in stabilizing and saving my cat's life. The followup information provided was timely, helpful and accurate.
My only issue is the severe sticker shock. This will cost you as much as treatment in a human hospital for similar services. But, if you love your pet, it's an emergency situation, and you decide to save your pet rather than euthanize them, there are very few other options. Thanks again.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!

We had a great experience. It did take a few weeks to get an appointment, which is completely understandable for a specialist, but it was well worth the wait. Everyone I interacted with was incredibly kind and knowledgeable. Dr. Simpson was wonderful-patient, compassionate, and thorough. She took the time to explain everything clearly, answer all of my questions, and make sure I understood the plan moving forward. I really appreciated the care and attention we received and would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking! Thanks again!

I've had two very good experiences with this office and would definitely go back. In both instances, one of our cats was acting weirdly. He's diabetic, so we kind of have to keep an eye on behavior changes. The latest time we came in, the nurse that triaged us was Michelle, who was absolutely amazing. So chill and helpful, incredibly knowledgeable. We did wait quite a while, but based on what Michelle told me I wasn't sure we actually needed to speak to a vet. I asked to see her again and and she was comfortable with that idea - her candor was so appreciated. At that point, I just wanted to get my guy home. Because we didn't see a vet, there was no charge, which blew me away. All the staff were excellent. I think this is a good place.
They were great and transparent about the costs. They took care of our baby.

Excellent service and attention.

We arrived on a Sunday with our very sick puppy. The staff immediately came to her, examined her, gave us possible diagnoses, and were always honest with us about my little Bella's health.
They have staff who speak Spanish, which I greatly appreciate because it helped us feel completely at ease.

Now my Bella is healthy and has recovered from gastroenteritis. I also saw how they cared for and helped other people who arrived with their pets. Without a doubt, it's a place I recommend and I'm grateful for their help.

I can’t say enough on how grateful I am for the staff, the doctors and the nurses at this facility!  My dog came in with ITP and was in the ICU for 4 days. They were so great with communication, support and treatment. They were so supportive, compassionate, caring and showed so much empathy for me and my little one. I was able to visit when I wanted, and speak to the care team. My little girl came home and we are still recovering but a big shoutout to this team for their amazing and dedicated support!

Let me start by saying I love animals and want nothing but the best care for everyone’s pet especially in emergency situations, so please don’t come here and go to a better emergency vet for the best care. I don’t want this to be too long, but I’ve had terrible experience and service with the facility and even though it is the closest emergency vet to me I will never be returning. To make a long story short, my dog was in respiratory distress after birth. The staff gave me multiple different condescending stories from different doctors about her condition. They made extremely insensitive comments to me and when I asked if “her puppies are going to be ok” the woman says “I would take them to a vet and make sure” a doctor also made a comment that my dogs that had puppies were siblings when I gave no inclination that was the case and it was deeply offensive and NOT TRUE. They would sound irritable every time I called and kept delaying giving me a call back. After 2 weeks of waiting to speak to someone all they could do was make excuses as to why they were not wrong and give me a $90 refund of an almost $5,000 bill. It seems they only care about how much money they will get from you as I feel they were making things up to me to do more tests and keep her there longer to charge. The best part is that any questions I had for them regarding the health of my pets or the procedures of my dogs visit, they didn’t know. They would tell me “I don’t know that’s not in our notes” or “you need to talk to a primary vet because we don’t know”. Please don’t waste time on this place. I’ve since been to an emergency vet called veg in Lincoln park and they made me feel 100X better to be there.

We are incredibly grateful to Dr. Simpson and the entire team for the care they provided to our dog, Ernie.

Ernie had been dealing with recurring GI issues for nearly two months, with countless vet visits, tests, medications, diet changes, and cycles of getting better only to get sick again. Things eventually escalated into a very scary emergency that required 24-hr hospitalization at another ER before he was transferred here.

Dr. Simpson was the first person who really seemed to step back, look at Ernie’s entire history, and start putting all of the pieces together. She was incredibly thorough and thoughtful, and took the time to clearly explain what she thought was happening, what we knew and didn’t know, and what the plan should be moving forward. After nearly two months of uncertainty, we finally feel like we have some answers and, more importantly, are seeing real progress.

What has impressed us just as much is the care after Ernie left the hospital. Dr. Simpson has continued to check in on him and his progress, and we were able to get an appointment with her within three weeks so she can continue overseeing his longer-term care. After spending so much time bouncing between appointments and treating individual episodes as they happened, having a doctor who knows his history and can help us manage this going forward means so much to us.

The entire team was wonderful. We never felt rushed or dismissed when we had questions. After such a long and stressful journey, finally feeling like we have both a path forward and someone helping us navigate it is an enormous relief.

We are so grateful Ernie ended up in her care and cannot recommend Dr. Simpson and Premier enough.

I am so grateful for this team's care as I navigate challenges with my cat Bee's health. Cameron and Dr Schaul are both wonderful - answering all my questions, easing my anxiety, and providing encouragement. I am especially grateful to Dr Schaul for being willing to ask a co-surgeon for a second opinion on the best path to healing. We are in the middle of Bee's healing journey with some unknown next steps- but the care we have received thus far has been a gift. Thank you 💓🐝

I brought my cat in 07-06-2026 at 9:30 am, 5+ hours later when the bill for tests, etc. resulted in diagnosis of asthma $1700, they wanted to keep him overnight for observation, another $1800. After I declined and agreed to fluids, I took him home, he improved at home but had congested nose so I called regular vet and picked up doxycycline for $13.00 for 7 day treatment which cleared his nose.  A week later regular vet found no evidence of asthma, he is back to normal and taking regular dose of prednisolone for his autoimmune disease. I will never go to “Premier” again or suggest anyone take their pet there.  Premier kept texting and email for review, I requested they contact me which they did not.
Benita Pennie
I brought my pup here in a panic and everyone was so competent and kind. They definitely have emergency prices, which is to be expected but it's wonderful service and I would highly recommend.
Don't go to that place; they endanger the lives of pets. They gave my dog ​​a bad diagnosis, and he died. I arrived in time to save his life, but he died because of you.
Have used your services more than once and have found each experience to be excellent and reasonably priced. Appreciate mostly the compassionate care of our furry kids

Saved my dog.... Twice. It's spendy, but I trust them as my first call. My dog had pyometra on a holiday during covid. Then 6 years later, they found and removed aggressive cancer. We are thankful for Dr Schaul, Dr Simpson and the rest of the team!

I had a really good experience here. From calling beforehand and being treated with such kindness over the phone, to having a series of extremely warm, informative and positive interactions with the front desk, vet tech, and 2 doctors, this place really cares about what they do. I went on a Sunday and was in and out in 1-2 hours. Highly recommend!

They are incredibly thorough and kept us updated as to our dog’s progress throughout the day. They reached out to other veterinarians in the area to ensure they had the most complete information for treatment.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!

I had a really great experience here, though I can only speak for Internal Med and not the ER center or other services. Despite the initial long wait to be seen for this specialty, I was called and offered a sooner appointment a week or two after setting up an appointment. My kitty was taken well care of by Dr. Simpson and her team. I'm very pleased with how communicative, thoughtful, and pleasant everyone I interacted with was. Despite the news about kitty's health not being so great, we have a plan to move forward. Dr. Simpson has been very helpful and I am hoping to continue kitty's treatment with her since I had such a positive experience.

The staff was quick, friendly and made sure I was updated every step of the way. I brought my dog in for an emergency and they already had the paperwork filled out for me so all I had to do was edit it. Nothing but good things to say about me and my dogs experience.

DO NOT BRING YOUR DOG HERE UNLESS YOU WANT THEM DEAD!
On a Wednesday my life was shifted for the worse. I went from living with my 2 year old pup to having to make the hardest decision of my life. When I brought him to Premier and explained to them my dog was sick, and had possibly swallowed something. They charged me 2,000 for an X-ray to see what was causing this issue. They then found that there was something in my pups intestines that needed to be removed immediately. They told me this surgery would cost $6,000. The DR made it seem as if the surgery was a guaranteed fix and my dog would snap right back, and be alive after. I paid because I needed my buddy to get better. I could not lose him.

Hours later the vet then say he isn’t looking good and possibly wouldn’t make it through surgery. 20 mins after that call they call back and say they are putting him under now. As I wait to hear, I finally get a call saying he made it through. At this moment there was a relief but that immediately change 2-3 hours later. I get a call that he isn’t doing good and it looks like he’s taking a turn. As an owner, this is the worse news I want to hear. They said he was more sick than they anticipated. Later that day they said hes now doing better. The following day I go to see him and they tell me he may need to stay for a few more days. With the intensive care he needed; 6,000 extra was needed. At that point my world stop. I was needing to make the decision to put my dog down because I could not afford any more additional cost. At this point I was sobbing, the lady at the front desk came in very rudely and said “you have two options, you will either pay the remaining balance or else” I nodded my head in disbelief. I couldn’t believe how this took a turn so many times. I then had to make the decision to put my 2 year old pup down because I couldn’t afford any additional 2 days. The doctor said he wouldn’t last the night if we took him home, and he wouldn’t last the drive to another hospital. At this moment I had to make the hardest decision of my life and was left no other choice but to put my 2 year old pup down. At this point I was being treated as if my dog meant nothing. Being asked questions such as “so did you decide?” “Do you need a minute?” “There’s nothing else we can do” it was cold and felt as if no one had my dog in their interest.

Even after I decided to put my dog down they then processed to ask for $600 more. After the fact I told them I had no more money left. The vet proceeds to say “well if you can’t afford it then you’ll have to take his body with you.”  This was certainly the worst 48hours of my life.

I am furious, destroyed, heartbroken, and essentially still in shock that there are companies out there that will choose money over saving a life. This makes me feel that this emergency vet never had my pups health as their number 1 priority and it’s all about how they can continue to scam people in order to keep their facilities open.

I will never recommend this place to anybody. These are not just animals they are family.

Update as of 07/05/2026- I am reflecting on the past 48hrs and decided what this vet did is not acceptable. I decided to post it everywhere and I am now having others telling me their stories with this vet! Everyone has horrible

Stories and are saying this vet only cares about money and has 0 bedside manners. I am furious and now questioning every medical decision they made. Please do not bring your pet here!!! My baby was only 2 years old and I am furious they took advantage of this situation!

"This clinic deserves ten stars. I rushed my dog in completely panicking because he was crying, panting, and acting erratic after stepping on fertilizer. The front staff immediately jumped in to help us, which I deeply appreciated. What really blew me away was our nurse. She was absolutely amazing. She not only took phenomenal care of my dog, but she also knew exactly how to calm my own racing anxiety and hypertension in that moment. Her compassion and kindness made a scary situation manageable. I am endlessly grateful to her and the whole team!" Thank you from the bottom of my heart for taking care of both me and little Louie my dog

My experience was truly wonderful. I called to explain the situation with my beloved fur baby, and when I arrived, they were already waiting to take her to the back for treatment. They took the time to explain everything to me and made sure I understood each step. I felt reassured and cared for, especially knowing what to do when my little one was going home. I am very grateful for their kindness and support. Thank you for your compassionate and excellent care!

Such kind staff!! When I came in I was scared of Bella’s (my dog) condition, but they reassured us in such a kind and comforting way while bringing back our Bella to her true self! Thankful for our visit 💝 …
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!

Dr Soltis cares about animals and their families. She demonstrates true empathy. Looked at my cat’s x-rays and provided sound guidance. I trust her and wish that all pet parents are lucky enough to have a caring advocate such as her. She will ask tough questions, but she is 100% invested in the best interest of her pet patients.
They made us feel very welcome. Also they took care of our jelly excellent they answered all our questions
Great service always

This business was great from setting up the appointment to checking out.  They were efficient, professional, polite and helpful. Dr. Christopher Brennan, their cardiologist, was amazing.  He looked incredibly young to us (we are no spring chickens), so at first we were surprised when he walked in.  But he was very knowledgeable, thorough and compassionate.  He explained everything well and never made us feel rushed when answering our many questions.  We will definitely be using Premier again.
Been here multiple times for both of my dogs are I’ve seen probably 8 diff staff members in those visits and all of them are so kind and patient !

I always take my dogs here for emergencies! They’re so quick & the care they have for pets are insane! Highly recommend. I was recommended by someone else and I tell everyone. It’s honestly the most reasonable ER that I can find!

I am writing this out of absolute frustration and heartbreak. I brought my cat here for an emergency visit involving a high fever and severe vomiting. I spent around $1,600 in less than 48 hours on diagnostic testing (bloodwork and X-rays). I was given absolutely no answers, no path forward, and was essentially told that "cats and fevers are confusing" and they may never know the cause.

Despite being sent home with clear bloodwork and clear X-rays, my cat continued to violently vomit through BOTH doses of her anti-nausea medications and was unable to keep water down. They advised me to do a round of antibiotics just in case it helps.

When I called the hospital back to advocate for my cat and ask for a ballpark trajectory of what our next treatment options or medications might look like (especially after taking a massive financial hit here) the staff completely shut down me down. They were very apathetic.

They refused to give me any guesstimates, or basic guidance over the phone, hiding behind the excuse that they are a "hospital, not a primary vet," and demanded I bring her back in to be evaluated (and undoubtedly charged) all over again.

Emergency medicine is expensive, and I understand that. What I do not accept is a complete lack of human compassion, a "pay-first" corporate wall, and a total refusal to provide basic follow-up guidance to a client. While they do need to protect themselves and ensure they get paid, the patients also may need an idea of how much money they’ll be spending because it’s undoubtedly going to be a large amount.

If you want a vet that treats you like a human being and partners with you during a terrifying crisis, avoid this corporate machine. There was one woman (I’m assuming a tech) who was absolutely kind to me and I appreciated her. But everything else puts a bad taste in my mouth. They care about the transaction, not the patient or the owner.
Everything and everyone are great. We have been there before and will continue to bring our pet there. Very professional and friendly staff.
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!
The care they show both you and your fur baby is impeccable.
Positive experience for me and my dog! The staff was so kind and patient and Dr. Simpson explained our results and options very clearly!

These people are cruel and will take your money. After paying $9000 and another $650 to put our 2 year old pup to sleep. They are asking for another $50 to cremate him to not even keep the ashes. Then told us if we don’t pay the $50 we have to pick up his decaying body that has been sitting there for 3 days!!!

If you see this, then it's not too late to look for a better veterinary hospital. If I could give them 0 stars I would. They are just money hungry, you and your pet are just a dollar sign walking through those doors.

Worst experience, they had me waiting for three hours and still haven’t check on my dog. Never even gave us a reason or a check up so we left and we got a refund that was at least that they could do but the service was so bad. I don’t recommend this place at all. Don’t take your pets here. Please
Perfect.  Very welcoming and friendly.  Dr. Simpson and her staff are terrific.  They are very efficient and explain things clearly. Highly recommend.
If you love your animal take them somewhere else.  Forced to pay 10k and put my dog down after the fact
Completely Negligent - DO NOT take your animal here. Terrible place

Do not go to this place if you care about your animal especially if it’s anything requiring an emergency. Think twice about coming here because they will suck all of the money out of you or suggesting putting your dog down. The price estimate they give you will double after when they decide you need “after care” without any warning or they will suggest putting your animal down. Premier veterinary group lacks empathy and takes advantage of people. Go to a veterinary office that cares and loves animals.

I brought in my cat, who had not been eating or drinking and was extremely concerned with her health. I arrive shortly after 8 PM, and was not seen until after 11 PM by a doctor. So Much for the $225 to walk in the door for an emergency. The doctor guessed it was her teeth, but wasn’t sure. So I left with no diagnosis and an original bill for close to $1200 for medication, etc., the only bright spot of my whole experience, was Marina, who was very sweet at the desk. I ended up seeing another vet the next day who quickly diagnosed the issue, and only charged me a little over 500. I would try to find another emergency vet if you need one very very disappointed.
They took amazing care of my sweet kitty George. He's feeling better and hopefully will be fine

My 5 year old, Doggo, Kairoh, had surgery elsewhere (MedVet),  and there is no after surgery care there. I brought him here to Premier, the Staff was AMAZING! I was worried sick, cause he hadn't pooped in 6 days, post op. MedVet was no help at all. My triage professional, Adrian, took the time to ask me questions, showed caring, empathetic professionalism. They REALLY CARE here. Took a look at Kairoh, and sent us home much more at ease. And true enough, his prediction came true, Kairoh was able to go later that next early morning. Please come here, they are really good. Much better than that other place. I will be bringing my two pups for care here from now on. Thank you SO much Premier, Adrian, was SO great!!!
Felt more as a cash grab . They could not even read the X-rays .i would not go back

5 stars for the doctors and care! Had to subtract one for the price. It was over $3000 for my cat to spend one night getting fluids and nausea meds for gastroenteritis which I thought was a little bit ridiculous. There was also a nurse who gave us the price and was super dismissive when we were upset and trying to figure things out. I am not sure her name unfortunately but she was working Tuesday morning.

Dr. Brennan was wonderful with my sphynx, Aubrey. He was incredibly thorough and took the time to explain her echocardiogram in detail. More importantly, he gave Aubrey a clean bill of heart health, which was such a relief. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and  caring vet cardiologist.

Then what was truly bizarre is after the initial conversation, I had questions but the doc sent someone else but it seemed clear the doc was close because this person came back almost immediately with the doc's response. So I had to make the decision based on what the doc the day before had said because clearly this doc was incompetent and did not know how to handle this situation at all. It likely would have resulted in having to put my dog down anyway but I wish I had demanded that they stabilize her enough so that she could get an abdominal ultrasound to see if there was actually any blockage.  Given everything that I knew, I did not want to put my dog through unnecessary surgeries and treatments that might not ultimately help since she was 14 years old. The fact that this did not seem to be taken into consideration by the doctor was mind blowing. Between not listening to what I was saying and then not answering my questions and pushing the hospitalization seemed way out of line with what happened at the vet just 24 hours ago. I wish I'd demanded what I knew what was needed so that I could make arrangements for in-home euthanasia which is likely what would have been needed, in the end. Such a hard thing to go through and then to be treated with the disrespect and unprofessional manner that this doc treated me with - just absolutely unacceptable. In my opinion, she should not be talking to patients until she learns A)how to listen and B) how to talk to people when they are clearly upset. Also, the answer can't just be, it requires a $10,000 hospital stay with possible surgery and then tests and treatments and top of that. I believe that this vet thinks she's doing what is right for the dogs but she does not seem to understand that it's people who pay those bills and when they are exorbitantly high, offering financing but no alternatives -and dear God, is she not paying attention to the news and the instability that's happening across all industries?? Again, she should not be allowed to practice without some serious mentoring and having someone more senior who knows how to deal with patients. Or get a social worker to be the liason as they will likely know better how to deal with clients are faced with the decision of having to put their precious pet to sleep. Anyone who brings their pet into a place like this clearly cares for the wellbeing of that pet and are deeply afraid of what it ultimately can mean.
